Across frames 1–4, the viewpoint shifts and turns around the rack, alternately bringing the lower shelves closer and then blurring them as the camera rotates right. In frame 5, the rack is no longer visible and a woman stands roughly 1–2 m in front of the camera, slightly right of center, facing generally toward it with her gaze angled downward; another person is partly visible about 1–2 m behind and to her right near a counter or display case. The woman is beside a red cart or counter at waist level, while the second person is partly occluded by the display case and frame edge, indicating the camera wearer has turned from the merchandise toward the more open shop interior.
